name: G. G. Automotive Gears Limited
about: G. G. Automotive Gears Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of traction gears and pinions in India. It offers railway gears and shafts; forged components and machined blanks; industrial gears and gearboxes; and mining and earth-moving equipment spares. It also provides spur, helical, double herringbone, rings, and bevel/spiral bevel. G. G. Automotive Gears Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Dewas, India.
